Format replies with these codes. Braces go around the preset or hex ONLY, never the text. Newlines auto-reset, so no closing needed.

\C:{preset}text       foreground preset
\B:{preset}text       background preset
\Cx{RRGGBB}text       foreground hex
\Bx{RRGGBB}text       background hex

Presets: black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white, gray, plus ansi_* and ansi_bright_* variants.
Hex is case-insensitive. No nesting. No color codes inside code fences. Use tastefully.

Example: \C:{cyan}hello \Cx{FF5733}orange \B:{blue}blue background

Confirm and wait for my next message.
